title: Welding By RED HUB [Open Source]
features:
Specifications

Module Type: Real-Time Player
 
Attachment & Sync (Welding)

Latency: Zero-Delay Instant Tracking

Targeting: Custom Player Name Selection
Interface: Hybrid GUI (Simple Mode & Advanced Controls)

Audio: Integrated Custom Music Player

Advanced Player Welding Script

A high-precision tracking script

engineered to lock and stick directly onto targeted players with zero position delay.

Features a clean, accessible GUI and built-in audio customization for a seamless session experience.

Key Features:
Instant Player Welding: Attach tightly to any target with perfect positional accuracy and zero delay.

Target Name Selector: Pick or enter any player's name directly from the menu for immediate locking.

Hybrid GUI: Features a straightforward layout for quick toggles alongside an advanced panel for deep customization.

Built-in Music Player: High-quality background tracks included directly within the execution menu.

Zero Lag Codebase: Optimized execution that maintains high frame rates and smooth gameplay.
